ul.name: selection operations
ul.li: - allows the user to transform the current selection on the canvas
- allows the user to make a rectangular selection on the canvas, already exists
- allows the user to make an elliptical selection on the canvas
- allows the user to make a freeform selection on the canvas
- allows the user to make a polygonal selection on the canvas

selection.concept: The buttons for the select tools in the main toolbar should be flyout buttons, allowing the user to choose between rectangle, ellipse, lasso, and polygon selection tools from a single button. The transform selection tool is listed to be considered in planning, but does not need to be realized in the first step. We can add it later, together with selection feathering.
